External histology T1+T2 fusion

Inputs: IPMN_labels_total.xlsx defines paired T1/T2 IDs and risk labels.
Images: DATA/t1/images/ID.nii.gz and DATA/t2/images/ID_T2.nii.gz.
Exclude risk 0 (no risk). Risk 1 (low) maps to class 0; risk 2 (high) maps to class 1.
Apply the existing keep_histology rule: exclude either ID listed with 'no change' follow-up.
This preserves the current centralized cohort definition.
Only labeled pairs with both images are used; missing files raise an error.
External leave-one-center-out evaluation: seven experiments, centers 0 through 6.
Train on six centers and hold out the remaining center for test. No split CSV is used.
Within each source center, reserve 20% for validation (seed 42; stratify where possible).
The held-out center is never used for training, model selection or calibration.
Center order: 0 NYU, 1 CAD/MCF, 2 Northwestern/NU, 3 AHN, 4 MCA, 5 IU, 6 EMC.
The paired cohort differs from single-modality centralized cohorts.
The two inputs always stay together; random flips/rotations are synchronized.
Train for 40 epochs with BCEWithLogitsLoss, AdamW lr=0.001 and StepLR(30, 0.1),
matching centralized classification. Validation alone selects saved models.
Calibration uses only validation predictions: first ascending threshold with
specificity >=0.9; accept if sensitivity >=0.3, otherwise print fallback and use 0.5.

From this folder:
  bash main.sh --model densenet121 --data-path ../../../../Cyst-X-resampled/classification
Optional: --output-dir ./saved
This trains seven held-out-center models, calibrates, and evaluates uncalibrated/calibrated test results.
Outputs: saved/MODEL/foldN/{checkpoint.pth,model_loss.pth,model_acc.pth,model_auc.pth,log.json}
Calibration/evaluation default to model_auc.pth.
Aggregated outputs under saved/MODEL: thresholds.json, result.xlsx, result.txt,
result_calibrated.xlsx, result_calibrated.txt.
Spreadsheets include one case ID (T1), held-out center and the threshold for each calibrated case.
Text reports contain center-specific and pooled external metrics. No ROC PDF is generated.
Each folder retains its own fusion architecture; supported backbones follow model.py.
